name: Artificial Iridescence
source:
"She's perfect."

Clint married the girl of his dreams and moved to a new city with her. He was ready to navigate the highs and lows of their relationship, but nobody expected things to go out of control.

Artificial Iridescence is a short kinetic visual novel that tells the story of long-time sweethearts, Clint and Ava. In between lifestyle adjustments and a secret project, they learn to compromise. But when the gravity of how far reality is from how they imagined it to be, they realize that there's more to marriage than playing house. Forced to face the consequences of their choices, can they survive as husband and wife?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144740/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“她完美无缺。”

Clint娶了梦寐以求的女孩，并和她一起搬到一座新的城市。他已经做好准备，面对两人感情中的起起落落，但谁也没想到，事情会失去控制。

《Artificial Iridescence》是一部短篇单线视觉小说，讲述了相恋多年的Clint与Ava的故事。在适应新的生活方式与推进一项秘密计划的过程中，两人学会了妥协。然而，当现实与想象之间的巨大落差沉甸甸地压在心头时，他们终于意识到，婚姻远不只是过家家。被迫面对自己选择所带来的后果，他们的夫妻关系还能维持下去吗？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144740/]Steam[/url]]
